input.mask_policy: replace tokenizer mask literal with space before offset-token prefix; same for all candidates

selection.order: sha256 canonical JSON [42,purpose,record_id]; largest remainder source/class quotas for dev/calibration

training.checkpoint_selection: among trained checkpoints: maximum mean domain F1 at 0.5, then minimum historical FP, then earliest step; initial is a reference only
training.order: one seeded shuffle of selected fit; smoke first 3 optimizer steps count towards the same 300-step run

calibration.method: scalar binary NLL: bracketed golden-section search over log(T), 100 iterations, calibration only

threshold.rule: max mean domain F1 among unique calibrated dev scores with observed historical FPR<=0.01 and nonzero recall in both domains; ties fewer historical FP, then larger threshold

evaluation.failure_policy: report coverage and failures separately; never convert missing response to ham
evaluation.latency: warm per-record single-item forward on final validation; preparation and cold load separate

closed: all test/challenge/teacher/frozen reserve/Nazario/modern candidates/needs_review/full parquet; no day2 pipeline
